title: Why Memberships Matter So Much to Costco 💳 #Shorts
script: Costco is famous for selling products in bulk, but memberships are a major part of its business model. Customers pay an annual fee for access to its warehouses, creating recurring revenue before they even fill a cart. The company can then compete aggressively on merchandise pricing while encouraging members to return and get value from their fee. That combination of membership income and high volume retail is central to how the model works. Follow for more business facts.
